newsitem.title: UK: UK's Railtrack agrees move to accountability.
newsitem.headline: UK's Railtrack agrees move to accountability.

text.p: Britain's rail industry regulator OFRAIL said on Thursday it had reached an agreement with Railtrack Plc to make the rail infrastructure operator more accountable.
Railtrack has been under fire for its investment performance and the rail regulator John Swift has been pushing for changes to Railtrack's licence to give OFRAIL greater powers to monitor investment.

Swift said on Thursday that he had agreed with Railtrack's John Horton to work to produce a mutually-agreed licence amendment on making Railtrack publicly accountable for its network management plans.
Swift said Horton had also accepted that Railtrack should be accountable for the delivery of output measures and that there should be powers of enforcement if it failed to deliver.
